scope.reason: Revalidate publisher head-matter ordering and recompute printed paragraph labels from stored raw: local duplicate or OCR markers preserve surrounding labels, and Czech and Slovak separate opinions have independent numbering scopes. AST roles and labels have no separate feature storage. the plenary ruling roles, the formula lines, the takto lead-in and the record card's affected constitutional and other provisions are read one listed act per value, so the stored provision lists are recomputed from the stored card; paragraph text, ruling roles, separate-opinion headings, letter-spaced words and paragraph numbers are recomputed from the stored page, and none of them has feature storage of its own Signature roles are recomputed from the stored decision, matching judge titles as whole words; they have no feature storage of their own. Ruling roles also open after an SbNU nález caption and end at the signatures, the closing line and the instruction; they have no feature storage of their own. A bare signatory name directly under a closing or another signature line, the way the Court's judges sign a separate opinion, is a signature; signature roles are recomputed from the stored page and have no feature storage of their own. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Signature roles are recomputed from the stored decision through the shared Czech role grammar, which reads the office a judge signs under (the president or a member of an extended or grand chamber, the President of a top court); they have no feature storage of their own. Printed paragraph labels are read by one grammar: a label opens a paragraph except inside a date wrapped after its day or after a word its number belongs to, sub-paragraphs (`5.5.`) open their own and count as items beside the court's numbering, and positioned-line paragraphs are read by the one line-join owner; block text, boundaries and numbers are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own. In a typewriter-wrapped decision a list item no longer opens after a word its number belongs to, and a line set deeper than the one above goes on in its paragraph where the sentence runs into it; paragraph text and boundaries are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a bench recital printed before a takto: of its own line (Ústavní soud České republiky / v senátě rozhodl ve věci …) is intro, through the one shared Czech recital rule. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Read a character an RTF writes in a double-byte font as one lead and trail byte, and a byte the code page leaves undefined as U+FFFD with a reader warning rather than a C1 control character; characters have no separate feature storage.
